snippet.title: Version 3.0 Teaser - "A Sleepwalker's Confession" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
For a long time, we remained hidden from the world. But isolation alone is no longer enough to withstand the Creator's threat.
And because of that, Roscaelifer must take a new step forward—
The lighthouse still stands, because we have stood shoulder to shoulder.
And from here on, its light will reach farther still, until the night itself is ended!

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5·iOS·Android·PC·Xbox｜Version 2.8 "New: Eridan Sunset" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
